$comment: The organisation's Linear workflow: one per team, in order. type is Linear's state category. scripts/create-workflow.sh creates these states in a team; SKILL.md explains them.

states.name: Triage
states.description: A request arrived in the user's words, not yet classified. Leaves with a persona, a scope class, and a size: small to Todo, large to Spec.

states.name: Backlog
states.description: Accepted, not planned into a cycle.

states.name: Todo
states.description: Ready: the design section, the contract, and the dependencies it needs exist.

states.name: Spec
states.description: Intent being pinned down: interview, refine, spec; a feature gets its phased PRD. Leaves when the user reviewed the PRD or the spec is on the issue.

states.name: Design
states.description: HLD, LLD, ADRs; contracts and the DB model. Leaves when the user reviewed the design and the contracts exist.

states.name: Planned
states.description: The project's milestones and issues are cut and the foundation issue identified. Leaves when the issues are in a cycle with owned paths.

states.name: In Progress
states.description: Code and tests in the agent's own environment. Leaves when the PR is raised.

states.name: In Review
states.description: PR open; findings inline and as review issues; every thread resolved. Leaves when approved, or review made optional and CI green.

states.name: QA
states.description: Independent verification of a milestone's usable outcome, end to end and under concurrency. A failure is a bug issue.

states.name: Merged
states.description: In main, releasable, changelog line added; build and deploy pending. Leaves when deployed.

states.name: Blocked
states.description: Cannot continue; the status update carries the blocker block. Returns to the state it left.

states.name: Done
states.description: Deployed and exercised where the issue says (production by default). A regression is a new bug.

states.name: Duplicate
states.description: Another issue tracks it; related as duplicate.
